note: Generic landmark: carved waystone on a stepped stone base, gold rune pulses. 32x48, footprint rows 32-47. Every element landmark is this marker plus an element indicator in the indicator slot; a landmark with no element is the marker alone.
indicatorSlotNote: Draw an element_indicator_* frame with its anchor at this pixel of the marker frame (front-right of the base), after the marker.
addonSlotNote: Draw a merchant/lair add-on frame with its anchor at this pixel of the marker frame (front-left of the base), after the marker and indicator. Add-ons spill past the frame to the left (up to x=-5).
flagSlotNote: Draw flag_top_* / flag_raise_* with its anchor (pole foot) at this pixel: the top of the pillar. Draw after the marker, before indicator and add-on.
